info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Human Resource Management Human Resources Direction By Human Resources Direction Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of Human Resources Directions within the Banking domain. It allows for updates to existing Human Resources Direction records identified by their unique IDs. Typical consumers include HR professionals and banking system integrators who require seamless updates to human resources data. This ensures that organizations maintain accurate and timely employee direction information to support effective human resource management.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific Human Resources Direction identified by the resource ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields that need to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to update specific attributes of a human resource record identified by RES-100045. It allows clients to send only the fields that need to be modified, thereby streamlining the update process.
